item.title: PREP BASEBALL BATS HEAT UP FOR BIG SWINGS ACROSS KEYS

item.title: IN PICTURES: GIGANTIC NAUTICAL MARKET BRINGS THOUSANDS FOR TWO DAYS OF SHOPPING
item.description: The Upper Keys Rotary produced the Gigantic Nautical Market at Founders Park on Feb. 21-22. More than 350 vendors, 20 food trucks, and nearly 150 student volunteers from Coral Shores High school greeted the attendees.
